steps: An existing stationary declaration opens with independent platform movement controls. An unchanged Check produces no Apply ticket or author writes.
Explicit horizontal motion rejects zero endpoint and zero speed without clamping, reviews schema5 while preserving unrelated source spellings and geometry, and Cancel discards the review.
Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain the same focused mode and reviewed source. Endpoint, speed and Check/Apply/Cancel remain reachable without horizontal overflow.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft. Save changes only the physics document; reopening restores endpoint and speed. Disabling movement retains schema5, and cancelling that review preserves the saved route.

Space-map offset and size controls each review exactly one geometry leaf while retaining platformMotion, character motion and any one-way declarations. Both reviews are cancelled before runtime testing.

Browser plan → Godot build → finite run records actual horizontal carriage in both directions for the zero-speed character, while the independent grounded character remains still. Existing landing feedback drives animation and audio commands. The observer shows the combined native solver request and displacement.

Instance and step filters plus previous/next preserve the admitted observations. Platform and character source actions independently select the exact /bodies/N author ranges; the platform source includes the reviewed movement declaration.
